learningObjectives: Distinguish synchronous execution from asynchronous execution.
Use async and await for I/O-bound operations.
Understand tasks, event loops, and concurrency trade-offs.

activities.title: Execution Timeline
activities.instruction: Compare the synchronous and asynchronous timelines.

content.concept: Synchronous code waits for each operation, while asynchronous code can switch between waiting tasks.

content.concept: async defines a coroutine and await pauses it while an asynchronous operation progresses.
